feedback.summary: Excellent work — you achieved full marks across all six questions. criteria.C1: You did well choosing two central attributes with scenario justification in Question 1, including your measurable "p95 response time is under 1.5 s and no requests are dropped". To stay Excellent, keep all six parts with measurable responses.
criteria.C2: You did well recommending a modular monolith in Question 2 with "Five developers running eight or more services would spend more time" plus downside. To stay Excellent, keep two scenario-specific trade-offs and acknowledge downside.
criteria.C3: You did well showing working for all three parts in Question 3, e.g., "A_new = 0.9995 × 0.999 × 0.9995 × 0.999975 = 0.99798". To stay Excellent, keep correct method and requested precision.
criteria.C4: You explained Circuit Breaker well in Question 4, including "After a wait it goes Half-Open and lets a few trial calls through" applied to the outage. To stay Excellent, keep application plus drawback/tuning.
criteria.C5: You justified AP for browsing and CP for payments in Question 5, noting "partitions cannot be ruled out in a distributed system, so partition tolerance is not optional". To stay Excellent, keep correct CAP use and concrete techniques.
criteria.C6: You wrote a specific ADR in Question 6 with Context, Decision and both consequences, e.g., "Delivery is at-least-once, so the tablet must ignore duplicate order IDs". To stay Excellent, keep positive and negative consequences.
criteria.C7: You kept every answer within 150 words with headings, precise terms and IEEE references. To stay Excellent, keep this clear formatting and citation discipline.
